正在试调，大约需要十几秒…: Probing models. This takes ten seconds or so…

还没有填写阿里云密钥，无法检测。: Add an Alibaba Cloud key first.
没有调通任何模型，请检查密钥和网络。: No model responded. Check your key and network.
密钥(明文存在本机应用数据目录): Keys (stored as plain text in the app data folder)
阿里云密钥同时用于国内转写、通义千问和模拟面试的语音合成；AssemblyAI: The Alibaba Cloud key also powers Qwen and the mock interviewer's voice. The AssemblyAI key also powers re-transcription for reviews.
模型名留空用默认值: Leave a model name empty to use the default
结束后自动整理(重新转写、翻译、问答评价和纪要): Process automatically when an interview ends (re-transcribe, translate, evaluate, summarize)
共享和截屏时隐藏: Hide from screen sharing and screenshots
悬浮窗在开始面试后出现，结束后收起。关闭鼠标穿透后可以直接拖动，拖边缘可调整大小: The overlay appears when an interview starts and hides when it ends. With click-through off you can drag it, and drag its edges to resize.
点组合键按钮后按下新的组合，必须带 ⌃、⌥ 或 ⌘；按 Esc 取消。: Click a shortcut, then press the new combination. It must include ⌃, ⌥ or ⌘. Press Esc to cancel.
%@ 已经用于\"%@\"，没有修改。: %@ is already used for "%@". Nothing changed.
麦克风还没有授权：录制自己的发言和模拟面试都需要: Microphone access hasn't been granted. Recording your voice and mock interviews both need it
麦克风权限被拒绝：请在系统设置里允许千人千面: Microphone access was denied. Allow InterviewCopilot in System Settings
一个密钥都没有填：只能本地转写，没有答案和复盘: No keys added. Only on-device transcription works, with no answers or reviews
当前大模型线路(%@)没有填密钥：没有答案和复盘: The selected model provider (%@) has no key. Answers and reviews are unavailable
面试进行中，结束后再测: An interview is running. Test after it ends
正在测试(如有权限弹窗请点允许)…: Testing (click Allow if a permission prompt appears)…
系统声音采集没有响应：请在系统设置里允许千人千面录制系统音频: System audio capture didn't respond. Allow InterviewCopilot to record system audio in System Settings
系统声音采集启动失败：%@: System audio capture failed to start: %@
采集已启动，这两秒里电脑没有出声。如果当时正在播放声音，说明权限没给: Capture started but the Mac was silent for those two seconds. If something was playing, the permission is missing
系统没有提供查询\"系统声音录制\"权限的办法，只能实际采集一下来判断。: macOS offers no way to query the system audio recording permission, so the only check is to try capturing.
答案和题目都从这里来: Answers and questions are built from these
面试进行中，结束后才能修改: An interview is in progress. Edit after it ends
英文面试优先用英文简历，中文面试优先用中文简历；只导入了一份时两种面试都用它。热: English interviews prefer the English résumé and Chinese interviews the Chinese one. With only one imported, it is used for both. Terms improve how names and jargon are transcribed, and changes apply the next time you start an interview.
选择%@文件(PDF、Word 或纯文本): Choose a file for %@ (PDF, Word or plain text)
按简历和岗位出题，语音提问，答完有点评和追问: Questions from your résumé and the role, asked aloud, with feedback and follow-ups
坐下来，像真的一样答一遍。: Sit down and answer as if it were real.
还没有填岗位描述，填了题目会更贴近岗位。: No job description yet. Adding one makes the questions fit the role.
建议戴耳机：外放时麦克风会录到面试官的声音。: Headphones are recommended. On speakers, the microphone picks up the interviewer's voice.
没有%@，出题改用%@: No %@, so questions will use the %@
还没有导入简历，只能出通用题: No résumé imported, so questions will be generic
这一场结束了，复盘已经生成。: This session is over and the review is ready.
答完第一题后，回答和点评会列在这里。: Your answers and feedback will appear here after the first question.
还没有面试记录。完成一场面试或模拟面试后会出现在这里。: No interviews yet. They appear here after an interview or a mock interview.
选择左边的一场面试: Select an interview on the left
删除这场面试的全部记录和录音？删除后无法恢复。: Delete all records and recordings of this interview? This can't be undone.
这场面试里同一位说话人的所有发言都会改名。: Everything this speaker said in this interview will be renamed.
点击可以修改标题，回车保存: Click to edit the title. Press Return to save
下面是面试当时的实时记录。点\"开始处理\"会重新转写、区分说话人、翻译全文，并: This is the live record from the interview. Process re-transcribes it, separates speakers, translates everything and writes evaluations and a summary.
双击一段发言从那里开始播放；右键可以改说话人的名字。: Double-click a line to play from there. Right-click to rename a speaker.
还没有纪要。处理完成后会显示在这里。: No summary yet. It appears here after processing.
听对方说话，实时出字幕、译文和回答提示: Live captions, translation and answer prompts while the other side speaks
开始后，对方说的话会出现在这里和悬浮窗里。: Once you start, what they say appears here and in the overlay.
还没有安装，现在只能转写: Not installed, so only transcription works
开始后悬浮窗出现，这个窗口收进程序坞；结束后恢复。: When you start, the overlay appears and this window goes to the Dock. It comes back when you end.
正在加载转写模型(首次可能要一分钟)…: Loading the transcription model (the first time can take a minute)…
正在启动系统声音采集(如有权限弹窗请点允许)…: Starting system audio capture (click Allow if a prompt appears)…
屏幕与系统音频录制 里允许本应用录制系统音频，然后重新开始。: Screen & System Audio Recording, allow this app to record system audio, then start again.
没有采到声音，请检查系统音频录制权限: No audio captured. Check the system audio recording permission
还没有填写%@的 API Key，请在主窗口填入并保存: No API key for %@. Add it in Settings
国内：通义千问(用阿里云密钥): China: Qwen (uses the Alibaba Cloud key)
大模型接口没有返回 HTTP 响应: The model API returned no HTTP response
真实面试正在进行，结束后才能开始模拟面试: A real interview is running. End it before starting a mock interview
还没有填写%@的密钥，无法出题: No key for %@, so questions can't be written
看完点评后点\"继续\": Read the feedback, then click Continue
请作答，答完点\"答完了\"或按回车: Answer now. Click I'm done or press Return when finished
没有麦克风权限，请在 系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 麦克风 里允许千人千面: No microphone access. Allow InterviewCopilot in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone
没有作答，不生成复盘: No answers, so no review was created
正在生成复盘(重新转写、翻译、评价和纪要)…: Building the review (re-transcribe, translate, evaluate, summarize)…
复盘没有全部完成，可以在历史复盘里继续处理: The review didn't finish. Resume it in Review history
未导入简历(只能给通用回答): No résumé imported (answers will be generic)
读不出这个 PDF 的文字(可能是扫描件): Couldn't read text from this PDF (it may be a scan)
文件里几乎没有文字: The file has almost no text
面试进行中这些快捷键在任何应用里都能用，主窗口不需要在前台。: During an interview these shortcuts work in any app. The main window doesn't need to be in front.
还没有导入。导入后会自动从中抽取公司名、项目名和技术名词作为热词。: Not imported yet. Once imported, company, project and technology names are extracted as terms automatically.
本地线路在本机离线转写，不需要密钥。: The local line transcribes offline on this Mac and needs no key.
密钥明文存在本机应用数据目录。: Keys are stored as plain text in the app's data folder on this Mac.
会后用 AssemblyAI 重新转写整场录音，区分说话人更准；不填就用本机离线: After the interview, AssemblyAI re-transcribes the whole recording and separates speakers more accurately. Without a key, the offline transcriber on this Mac is used.
阿里云密钥和转写共用，也用于模拟面试的语音合成。模型名留空用默认值。: The Alibaba Cloud key is shared with transcription and mock-interview speech. Leave model names empty to use the defaults.
打开官网申请或管理密钥: Open the provider's website to get or manage a key
发现更新的千问版本，可以在下面选择。: A newer Qwen version is available. Pick it below.
逐个试调版本号不低于当前的通义千问模型，以及 DeepSeek 和 Kimi 的: Tries every Qwen model at or above your current version, plus the latest DeepSeek and Kimi versions, and lists only the ones this account can call now. First-token latency is a single measurement and varies.
